questions.question: ‘A + B’ means ‘A is the wife of B’. ‘A – B’ means ‘A is the husband of B’. ‘A × B’ means ‘A is the son of B’. ‘A ÷ B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’. If T + Q × P – U ÷ R ÷ S + V, the how is R related to Q?
questions.questionHtml:
‘A + B’ means ‘A is the wife of B’.

‘A – B’ means ‘A is the husband of B’.

‘A × B’ means ‘A is the son of B’.

‘A ÷ B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’.

If T + Q × P – U ÷ R ÷ S + V, the how is R related to Q?
questions.solution:
T + Q × P – U ÷ R ÷ S + V

By decoding given expression,

T is wife of Q, Q is son of P, P is husband of U, U is mother of R, R is mother of S,

Both R and Q have same parents.

Hence, R is sister of Q.

questions.question: Which two signs should be interchanged to make the following equation correct? 18 + 24 – 6 × 6 ÷ 3 = 39
questions.questionHtml:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the following equation correct?

18 + 24 – 6 × 6 ÷ 3 = 39
questions.solution:
By interchanging ÷ and –

18 + 24 ÷ 6 × 6 - 3 = 18 + 4 × 6 - 3 = 18 + 24 - 3 = 39

By interchanging × and +

18 × 24 - 6 + 6 ÷ 3 = 18 × 24 - 6 + 2 = 432 - 6 + 2 = 428 ≠ 39

By interchanging + and –

18 - 24 + 6 × 6 ÷ 3 = 18 - 24 + 6 × 2 = 18 - 24 + 12 = 0≠39

By interchanging ÷ and +

\(18 \div 24 - 6 \times 6 + 3 = \frac{3}{4} - 36 + 3 = \frac{3}{4} - 33 \ne 39\)

Hence, by interchanging “÷ and -” we get correct answer.

questions.solution:

questions.question: The sum of the current ages of Vinayak his father is 50 years. 5 years from now, Vinayak’s age will be one - fifth of his father’s age. What is Vinayak’s current age?
questions.questionHtml: The sum of the current ages of Vinayak his father is 50 years. 5 years from now, Vinayak’s age will be one - fifth of his father’s age. What is Vinayak’s current age?
questions.solution:
Vinayak’s father’s age = X

Vinayak’s age = Y

Sum of theirs ages is 50.

So,

X + Y = 5

By taking second condition,

\(\left( {X\; + \;5} \right) \times \frac{1}{5} = \left( {Y + 5} \right)\)

X + 5 = 5Y + 25

X = 5Y + 20

Putting the value of X,

5Y + 20 + Y = 50

6Y = 30

Y = 5

Hence, Vinayak’s current age is 5 years.

questions.question: Two statement are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements. Statements: All owls are parrots. Some parrots are crows. Conclusions: I. No owl is a crow. II. All parrots are owls. III. Some owls are crows.
questions.questionHtml:
Two statement are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All owls are parrots.

Some parrots are crows.

Conclusions:

I. No owl is a crow.

II. All parrots are owls.

III. Some owls are crows.

options.text: Either conclusion I or III Follows
options.html: Either conclusion I or III Follows

options.text: Only conclusion II and III follows.
options.html: Only conclusion II and III follows.

options.text: All the conclusions, I, II and III, follow
options.html: All the conclusions, I, II and III, follow

options.text: Either conclusion I or II follows
options.html: Either conclusion I or II follows

questions.solution:
The least possible diagram is,

I. No owl is a crow → False (Possible but not definite)

II. All parrots are owls → False (Possible but not definite)

III. Some owls are crows → False (Possible but not definite)

Conclusion I and III both are false and complimentary.

Hence, either conclusion I or III Follows.

questions.question: British East India Company defeated the Portuguese in the ___________.
questions.questionHtml: British East India Company defeated the Portuguese in the ___________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Battle of Suvali​.

Key Points

  • In 1612 the East India Company's ships defeated the Portuguese in the Swally estuary off Surat.
  • The naval Battle of Swally, also known as Battle of Suvali, took place on 29–30 November 1612 off the coast of Suvali a village near the Surat city and was a victory for four English East India Company galleons over four Portuguese galleons.
  • This relatively small naval battle is historically important as it marked the beginning of the ascent of the English East India Company's presence in India.
  • This battle also convinced the English East India Company to establish a small navy to safeguard their commercial interests from other European powers and also from pirates. 
  • The background to this battle also points to the main reason for the Dutch Vereenigde Oostindische Compagnie being organized in 1602.

questions.question: The efficiencies of A, B and C are in the ratio 2 : 5 : 3. Working together, they can complete task in 9 days. In how many days will C alone complete 40% of that task?

The efficiencies of A, B and C are in the ratio of 2 : 5 : 3

Total work = (2 + 5 + 3) × 9 = 90

40% of the total work = 90 × 40/100 = 36

40% of the total work completed by C in = 36/3 = 12 days

questions.question: In a circle with centre O, an arc ABC subtends an angle of 140° at the centre of the circle. The chord AB is produced to point P. Then ∠CBP is equal to:
questions.questionHtml: In a circle with centre O, an arc ABC subtends an angle of 140° at the centre of the circle. The chord AB is produced to point P. Then ∠CBP is equal to:
questions.solution:
The angle subtended by an arc at the centre of a circle is double the size of the angle subtended by the same arc at the circle circumference

Take any point Q on the circumference and join AQ and QC .

∴ ∠AOC = 2 × ∠AQC

⇒ ∠AQC = 1/2 × ∠AOC = 1/2 × 140° = 70°

Now, ∠CBP = ∠AQC [Exterior angle of cyclic quadrilateral]

⇒ ∠CBP = 70°

questions.question: The difference between the compound interest and simple interest on Rs.x at 7% per annum for 2 years is Rs. 24.50. What is the value of x?

questions.question: If cosec 4θ = sec (60° – 2θ), then θ is equal to:
questions.questionHtml: If cosec 4θ = sec (60° – 2θ), then θ is equal to:
questions.solution:
Given:

cosec 4θ = sec (60° – 2θ)

Formula Used:

If cosec A = cosec B then A = B and vice-versa

if cosec A = sec B then A = 90° - B

Calculation:

cosec 4θ = sec(60° – 2θ),

⇒ cosec 4θ = cosec[90° – (60° – 2θ)] [cosec(90 – θ) = sec θ]

⇒ 4θ = 90° – 60° + 2θ

⇒ 2θ = 30°

∴ The value of θ is 15°.

questions.question: Walking at 3/5 of his usual speed, a person reaches his office 20 minute later than the usual time. His usual time in minutes is:
questions.questionHtml: Walking at 3/5 of his usual speed, a person reaches his office 20 minute later than the usual time. His usual time in minutes is:
questions.solution:
Calculation:

As we know, time is inversely proportional to speed.

Let the usual speed of the person be 5x

Speed of the person after decreasing = 3x

Ratio of usual speed to after decreasing = 5x : 3x

Ratio of usual time to after decreasing = 3x : 5x

5x – 3x = 20

⇒ x = 10

3x = 10 × 3 = 30 min

∴ The usual time was 30 minutes.

questions.question: Find the value of 108 ÷ 36 × 4 + 2.5 × 4 ÷ 0.5 – 10
questions.questionHtml: Find the value of 108 ÷ 36 × 4 + 2.5 × 4 ÷ 0.5 – 10
questions.solution:
Follow BODMAS rule to solve this question, as per the order is given below :

Step-1 : Parts of an equation enclosed in 'Brackets' must be solved first and in the bracket,

Step-2 : Any mathematical 'Of' or 'Exponent' must be solved next,

Step-3 : Next, the parts of the equation that contain 'Division' and 'Multiplication' are calculated,

Step-4 : Last but not least, the parts of the equation that contain 'Addition' and 'Subtraction' should be calculated.      

⇒ 108 ÷ 36 × 4 + 2.5 × 4 ÷ 0.5 – 10

⇒ 3 × 4 + 2.5 × 8 – 10

⇒ 12 + 20 – 10

⇒ 22

questions.question: In the sentence identify the segment which contains the grammatical error. Having just taking a heavy lunch, she was not ready to have any fruit.
questions.questionHtml:
In the sentence identify the segment which contains the grammatical error.

Having just taking a heavy lunch, she was not ready to have any fruit.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'taking a heavy lunch'.

Key Points

  • In this part of the sentence, there is an error in the given part - 'taking a heavy lunch'.
  • 'taking' should be replaced by 'taken'.
  • The structure 'having taken' is a perfect participle which functions as an adverbial modifier of time.
  • Hence, the correct sentence is- 'Having just taken a heavy lunch, she was not ready to have any fruit.'

Hence, the correct answer will be Option 3.

Important Points

  • An adverbial modifier is a word or phrase that modifies another part of a sentence, typically a verb or adjective.
    • Adverbs of time tell us when an action happened, but also for how long, and how often. Adverbs of time are invariable. 
    • Soon now, later, then, tomorrow, today, day after tomorrow, everyday, weekly, annually, quarterly, yearly, yesterday, last month, tonight, last week, immediately, etc. are some examples of adverbs of time.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. accomplish.

C. It is also lined with beautiful potted plants to give it a green look.

D. Visitors to the busy Karol Bagh market in Delhi were in for a surprise.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "DABC"

Key Points

  • D should be first as it clearly gives an introduction of what is being talked about in the following sentences i.e. the markets. After D, it should be A as A tells why the visitors were in for a surprise. Now, it would be B as C contains the word also which means that before C, something has already been described in the market. So C will be last

The correct sequence is given in Option 4.

questions.solution:

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. Following detailed deliberations, the meeting has been _______ till next week
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Following detailed deliberations, the meeting has been _______ till next week
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 4.

Reviewed means view or inspect again.

Cancelled means decide or announce that (a planned event) will not take place.

Proposed means put forward (a plan or suggestion) for consideration by others.

Adjourned means break off (a meeting, legal case, or game) with the intention of resuming it later.

The most appropriate word is adjourned as it means that the meeting has been stopped till next week.
